summary: Inspected thys/CSP_RefTK/DiningPhilosophers.thy (53658 bytes). This is a substantial formal Isabelle/HOL theory file that models the Dining Philosophers problem using CSP refinement techniques. It contains a locale parameterized by N>1, datatype definitions for dining events, process definitions for philosophers and forks, normal form translations with refinement proofs (using fixed-point induction), composition of philosopher/fork networks, invariant proofs, and deadlock-freedom theorems. Every section contains definitions, lemmas, and proofs — genuine formal mathematical content.
